Build Sprint 6 — Artist profiles + schedules + multi-user invites + roles. Working dir: `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/InkOS`.

**Inputs:**
- Design spec: `.handoffs/sprint-6-design-spec.md` (sidebar HIDE not LOCK for role gating, bottom-sheet on mobile, schedule grid scrolls to 08:00, PermissionsContext fetched once at layout level, copy schedule = DELETE+INSERT vs merge)
- Migration handoff: `.handoffs/sprint-6-dato-migration.md`
- Migration LIVE: `supabase/migrations/20260416000002_artist_schedules_invites.sql` (6 tables, 10 RPCs incl replaced `public_get_availability`, 105 role_permissions seed rows, `user_is_studio_admin()` helper, `handle_invite_acceptance` trigger)
- Types updated already

**CRITICAL gotcha from Dato:** `accept_team_invite` RPC does NOT copy `commission_default_pct` to `artists.commission_default_pct`. Koda must do this in the post-acceptance route handler.

**Sprint 6 scope — execute Vega's 14-16 step build:**

1. **PermissionsContext** — server-side fetch at `app/(app)/layout.tsx` from `role_permissions` for caller's role (join via `studio_members` with `deactivated_at IS NULL`). Serialize to context provider. All components use `usePermissions()` hook for UI gating. Zero per-page refetch.

2. **Role-aware sidebar** — Filter sidebar items using permissions. HIDE items role can't access (not lock). Plan-gated items still show lock+tier chip (from Sprint 4). Update `lib/auth/nav.ts` from Sprint 1 to consume permissions.

3. **Artists list** at `/artists` — Grid/table toggle. Cards show: avatar, display_name, role chip, status pill, specialties chips, # bookings this month (join), commission_default_pct, calendar_color dot. Filters: status/specialty/role. "+ Add Artist" (placeholder record) vs "Invite Artist" (team_invite + link to artist record via `artist_id`).

4. **Artist detail** at `/artists/[id]` with tab URL segments:
   - `/artists/[id]` Profile (default)
   - `/artists/[id]/schedule`
   - `/artists/[id]/performance`
   - `/artists/[id]/team`
   Layout renders `ArtistHero` + Tabs (Link+usePathname). Each tab is own server component.

5. **Profile tab** — edit display_name, bio, portfolio_url, avatar (upload to `studio-assets` with folder prefix), calendar_color (swatch picker from design spec 10-swatch palette), specialties (multi-add), hourly_rate_cents, min_age_cut_off, accepts_walk_ins, max_bookings_per_day, profile_bio_public, languages_spoken, social_instagram, social_portfolio. Status dropdown (active/on_leave/archived).

6. **Schedule tab** — weekly recurring schedule editor:
   - 7-day grid (Sun-Sat columns, time rows). Scroll-into-view on mount at 08:00.
   - Drag-to-create slot (15-min snap). Click slot to edit start/end/location. Delete on click-X.
   - Location picker per slot (null = default location).
   - Effective date range (from/until) with "active now" indicator.
   - One-off `artist_time_off` panel below the grid: list + "+ New time off" modal (start/end datetime, reason dropdown from CHECK: vacation/sick/personal/training/other, notes). Artist role submits status=pending; owner/admin sets status=approved directly. Inline approve/deny on pending rows.
   - `artist_blocked_dates` compact list (one-off single-day) with add/remove.
   - "Copy schedule from another artist" → dialog with source artist picker + radio (Replace=DELETE+INSERT vs Merge=selective INSERT where no existing slots).

7. **Performance tab** — placeholder stats (booking count, revenue, no-show rate). Full charts Sprint 12. Commission stub (Sprint 7 will fill).

8. **Team tab** (within artist detail) — membership metadata: role, joined_at, last_active_at, deactivate button (owner only).

9. **Schedule overview** at `/artists/schedules` — multi-artist weekly view (rows=artists, cols=days). Read-only overview. Click cell → drill to artist schedule editor.

10. **Team settings** at `/settings/team` with sub-tabs:
    - **Members** — table: avatar+name, email, role, joined_at, last_active_at (relative), status. Owner-only actions: change role (modal with audit note input), deactivate, reactivate. Filter `deactivated_at IS NULL` by default; toggle show deactivated.
    - **Invites** — pending invites table: email, role, invited_by, sent_at, expires_at (countdown), status, actions (resend, revoke). "+ Invite Member" CTA.

11. **Invite modal** (from Members tab or Invites tab):
    - Email input + validation (format + not already in studio_members)
    - Role cards: admin/artist/receptionist/guest_artist with 1-sentence descriptions
    - If role=artist: commission_default_pct input (default 50) + optional "Link to existing unclaimed artist profile" dropdown (artists WHERE profile_id IS NULL)
    - Personal message textarea
    - Mobile: Bottom Sheet not Dialog; sticky submit; role cards stack
    - Submit → POST `/api/team-invites` → calls `create_team_invite` RPC → sends email via Resend with `/invite/[token]` link

12. **Public invite accept** at `/invite/[token]` — ANON public route using `lib/supabase/public.ts`:
    - Fetch via anon RPC `get_invite_by_token`: returns studio name, inviter name, role label, expires_at (NOT email — no PII leak)
    - Expired/invalid token → error state with "Request new invite" link
    - Logged-in user with matching email: "Accept invitation" button → POST `/api/team-invites/[token]/accept` → **after RPC, if role=artist AND invite.artist_id EXISTS: PATCH the linked artist.commission_default_pct from invite.commission_default_pct** (Dato gotcha) → redirect to dashboard with toast
    - Logged-in user with mismatched email: "This invite was sent to another email" error
    - Not logged in: "Sign in" + "Create account" CTAs. Pass `?next=/invite/[token]` so post-auth redirects back here and auto-accepts.

13. **Permissions matrix viewer** at `/settings/team/permissions` — read-only table. Columns: permission key (grouped by category: bookings/clients/artists/billing/etc.), each role as column with check/cross icon. Educational (no edit).

14. **My Profile** at `/settings/profile` — user edits own profile + their linked artist record (if any):
    - Name, email (read-only from auth), avatar upload, preferred_timezone (from studios or user override), notification prefs (placeholder for Sprint 11 marketing)
    - If is_linked_artist: show own artist editor (subset of Profile tab from artist detail)
    - Display studio memberships (read-only).

15. **Last-active tracking** — In `getAuthenticatedUser()` helper (Sprint 1), update `studio_members.last_active_at = now()` for the active studio on every authed call. Throttle to 1/minute per user via Upstash cache (don't DB-write if last update was <60s ago). Display relative time on members list.

16. **Calendar color usage** — In Sprint 2 calendar, update `CalendarView` to read `artists.calendar_color` hex directly instead of the `(sort_order - 1) % 10 + 1` fallback. If calendar_color null, still fall back to palette cycle.

**API routes to create/update:**
- `app/api/artists/route.ts` — GET (already exists from Sprint 2, enrich with new fields) POST (create placeholder artist without invite)
- `app/api/artists/[id]/route.ts` — GET, PATCH (full artist fields), DELETE (soft → status=archived)
- `app/api/artists/[id]/schedule/route.ts` — GET resolved schedule for range (uses `get_artist_schedule_for_range` RPC), PUT (bulk upsert weekly grid)
- `app/api/artists/[id]/time-off/route.ts` — GET, POST
- `app/api/artists/[id]/time-off/[timeOffId]/route.ts` — PATCH (approve/deny/cancel), DELETE
- `app/api/artists/[id]/blocked-dates/route.ts` — GET, POST, DELETE
- `app/api/artists/[id]/copy-schedule/route.ts` — POST (body: {source_artist_id, mode: 'replace' | 'merge'})
- `app/api/team-invites/route.ts` — GET (list pending for studio), POST (calls `create_team_invite` RPC)
- `app/api/team-invites/[id]/route.ts` — DELETE (revoke via `revoke_team_invite` RPC)
- `app/api/team-invites/[id]/resend/route.ts` — POST (re-enqueues email, updates reminder_sent_at)
- `app/api/team-invites/[token]/accept/route.ts` — POST (calls `accept_team_invite`, then patches artist commission if needed)
- `app/api/studio-members/route.ts` — GET list
- `app/api/studio-members/[userId]/route.ts` — PATCH role (calls `change_member_role`), DELETE deactivate (calls `deactivate_member`)
- `app/api/studio-members/[userId]/reactivate/route.ts` — POST (owner/admin)
- `app/api/role-permissions/route.ts` — GET (for matrix page, returns grouped by category)
- `app/api/profile/route.ts` — GET, PATCH

**Public API routes (anon):**
- `app/api/public/invites/[token]/route.ts` — GET (calls `get_invite_by_token` anon RPC)

**Email templates (extend Sprint 4 Resend):**
- `team_invite` — studio name, inviter name, role, personal message, accept URL, expires_at
- `team_invite_reminder` — 3 days before expiry
- `invite_accepted` — to inviter
- `role_changed` — to target user
- `member_deactivated` — to target user

**Shared components:**
- `components/artists/ArtistsList.tsx` (grid/table toggle)
- `components/artists/ArtistCard.tsx`
- `components/artists/ArtistHero.tsx`
- `components/artists/ProfileForm.tsx`
- `components/artists/CalendarColorPicker.tsx` (10 swatches)
- `components/artists/SpecialtiesInput.tsx`
- `components/artists/schedule/WeeklyScheduleEditor.tsx` (7-day drag grid)
- `components/artists/schedule/ScheduleSlot.tsx`
- `components/artists/schedule/TimeOffPanel.tsx`
- `components/artists/schedule/TimeOffModal.tsx`
- `components/artists/schedule/BlockedDatesList.tsx`
- `components/artists/schedule/CopyScheduleDialog.tsx`
- `components/artists/schedule/SchedulesOverview.tsx` (multi-artist week view)
- `components/team/MembersTable.tsx`
- `components/team/InvitesTable.tsx`
- `components/team/InviteMemberModal.tsx` (Dialog desktop / Sheet mobile)
- `components/team/RoleCard.tsx`
- `components/team/ChangeRoleModal.tsx`
- `components/team/PermissionsMatrix.tsx`
- `components/team/DeactivateMemberModal.tsx`
- `components/invite/InviteAcceptPage.tsx` (public, anon)
- `components/invite/InviteExpiredState.tsx`
- `components/profile/ProfileForm.tsx`
- `components/providers/PermissionsProvider.tsx`
- `hooks/use-permissions.ts`

**Hard rules:**
- Zero `any`, zero `console.log` (use `lib/logger.ts`), zero raw hex outside brand swatch (calendar_color is approved exception)
- `@supabase/ssr` only. `getUser()` never `getSession()`
- Never trust client-sent `studio_id` on authed routes
- Public invite route uses `lib/supabase/public.ts`
- Use `getClientIp` from Sprint 4 + `authedRatelimit` / `apiRatelimit`
- base-nova `render` not `asChild`
- `animationFillMode: "both"` on staggered lists
- All new email templates use Resend worker from Sprint 4, write to `client_communications` (extended to support `user_id` for team emails, or use separate `team_communications` — if not in migration, add to `client_communications` or log to `audit_log`). Since there's no team_communications table, log sends via `team_audit_log` + `audit_log` generic.
- Mutations → Sonner toast
- Validate email uniqueness in studio_members before inviting (via `create_team_invite` RPC)
- Members list filters `deactivated_at IS NULL` by default

**Stubs deferred:**
- Commission earned on Performance tab (Sprint 7)
- Full performance charts (Sprint 12)
- Notification preferences persistence (Sprint 11)

**Pattern references:**
- `~/.claude/memory/patterns/good/ui-ux-production-standards.md`
- `~/.claude/memory/patterns/good/sidebar-patterns.md`
- `~/.claude/memory/patterns/good/saas-winning-patterns.md`
- `~/.claude/memory/patterns/good/auth-patterns.md`
- `~/.claude/memory/patterns/good/executable-validation-gates.md`
- `.handoffs/sprint-1-design-spec.md` through `.handoffs/sprint-5-design-spec.md`

**Validation — all 4 gates before returning:**
```bash
pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm build && pnpm test
```

**Deliverables:**
1. All 4 gates green
2. `.handoffs/sprint-6-build-report.md`: file inventory, deviations, stubs, acceptance criteria
3. Short summary: file counts, any blockers

Do NOT touch Sprint 7+ scope (commissions). Preserve all prior sprint work.

1	# Sprint 6 — Dato Migration Handoff
2	**Migration:** `supabase/migrations/20260416000002_artist_schedules_invites.sql`
3	**Date:** 2026-04-16
4	
5	---
6	
7	## Table Inventory
8	
9	| Table | Type | Ownership | RLS Scope |
10	|---|---|---|---|
11	| `artist_schedules` | New | studio_id | Tenant read; artist self-manage; owner/admin full |
12	| `artist_time_off` | New | studio_id | Tenant read; artist submit own; owner/admin approve |
13	| `artist_blocked_dates` | New | studio_id | Tenant read; artist manage own; owner/admin full |
14	| `team_invites` | New | studio_id | Tenant read; owner/admin write; anon via RPC only |
15	| `role_permissions` | New (seed) | static | Authenticated SELECT only; no app writes |
16	| `team_audit_log` | New | studio_id | Owner/admin SELECT only; service-role/DEFINER writes |
17	| `artists` | Extended | studio_id | Unchanged; UPDATE now role-scoped (Sprint 6) |
18	| `studio_members` | Extended | studio_id | Unchanged RLS; 4 new columns |
19	
20	---
21	
22	## Role-Permission Matrix (seed rows — 109 total)
23	
24	Seeded via `INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`. Safe to re-run.
25	
26	### owner
27	All permissions including: `billing.cancel_studio`, `studio.delete`, `admin.change_roles`, `payroll.manage`, `settings.billing`.
28	
29	### admin
30	All except: `billing.cancel_studio`, `studio.delete`, `admin.change_roles` (cannot self-promote to owner or delete studio).
31	Includes: `payroll.view`, `commissions.view`, `commissions.manage`, `settings.team`, `settings.studio`.
32	
33	### artist
34	Scoped to own data: `bookings.read_own`, `bookings.create`, `bookings.update_own`, `clients.read_own`, `clients.create`, `artists.read_own`, `artists.update_own`, `calendar.read_own`, `calendar.manage_own`, `commissions.view_own`, `consent.view_own`, `inventory.read`, `ai.use`.
35	
36	### receptionist
37	Broad booking + client access, no payroll/commissions: `bookings.read_all`, `bookings.create`, `bookings.update_any`, `bookings.cancel_any`, `clients.read`, `clients.create`, `clients.update`, `artists.read`, `calendar.read_all`, `calendar.manage_any`, `consent.view_all`, `consent.send_request`, `inventory.read`, `settings.booking_page`.
38	
39	### guest_artist
40	Minimal: `bookings.read_own`, `bookings.create`, `bookings.update_own`, `clients.read_own`, `artists.read_own`, `artists.update_own`, `calendar.read_own`, `calendar.manage_own`, `commissions.view_own`.
41	
42	Permission domains covered: `bookings.*`, `clients.*`, `artists.*`, `calendar.*`, `payroll.*`, `commissions.*`, `settings.*`, `billing.*`, `consent.*`, `inventory.*`, `ai.*`, `admin.*`.
43	
44	---
45	
46	## RPC Contracts
47	
48	### `create_team_invite(p_studio_id, p_email, p_role, p_commission_pct?, p_personal_message?, p_artist_id?)` → `jsonb`
49	- Caller: authenticated, must be owner/admin of studio
50	- Returns: `{ invite_id, invite_token, expires_at }` or `{ error: string }`
51	- Error codes: `unauthorized`, `invalid_email`, `invalid_role`, `already_a_member`
52	- Side-effects: expires any existing pending invite to same email+studio; writes `team_audit_log` action `invited`
53	
54	### `revoke_team_invite(p_invite_id)` → `boolean`
55	- Caller: authenticated, owner/admin
56	- Sets `status = 'revoked'`; writes `team_audit_log` action `invite_revoked`
57	- Returns `false` if invite not found, not pending, or caller lacks permission
58	
59	### `accept_team_invite(p_invite_token)` → `jsonb`
60	- Caller: authenticated (caller's profile.email must match invite.email — case-insensitive)
61	- Returns: `{ studio_id, studio_name, role, redirect }` or `{ error: string }`
62	- Error codes: `not_authenticated`, `invite_not_found`, `invite_already_used`, `invite_expired`, `email_mismatch`, `already_a_member`
63	- Side-effects: trigger `on_invite_accepted` fires → inserts `studio_members`, optionally claims `artists.profile_id`, writes `team_audit_log`
64	
65	### `get_invite_by_token(p_token)` → `jsonb`
66	- Caller: **anon-safe** (GRANT to `anon`). Used by invite-accept page before user logs in.
67	- Returns: `{ studio_name, studio_slug, studio_logo, invited_by_name, role, expires_at, status, personal_message }`
68	- No mutations. No PII leakage. Safe to expose publicly.
69	
70	### `change_member_role(p_studio_id, p_user_id, p_new_role)` → `boolean`
71	- Caller: authenticated, **owner-only** (not admin)
72	- Prevents demoting last owner
73	- Writes `team_audit_log` action `role_changed`
74	
75	### `deactivate_member(p_studio_id, p_user_id)` → `boolean`
76	- Caller: authenticated, owner/admin
77	- Soft-removes (sets `deactivated_at`); cannot deactivate owner
78	- Writes `team_audit_log` action `member_deactivated`
79	- Row is retained for audit. Filter `deactivated_at IS NULL` for active members.
80	
81	### `get_artist_schedule_for_range(p_artist_id, p_start, p_end)` → `SETOF jsonb`
82	- Caller: authenticated
83	- Returns one row per calendar date with: `date`, `day_of_week`, `schedule_windows[]`, `is_time_off`, `is_blocked`, `existing_bookings[]`
84	- Used by: internal calendar view and availability pre-check
85	
86	### `public_get_availability(p_artist_id, p_service_id, p_date)` → `jsonb` (REPLACED)
87	- This is the Sprint 2 stub, now replaced with real schedule-aware logic.
88	- Caller: **anon-safe** (existing GRANT preserved)
89	- Logic order: time_off check → blocked_date check → artist_schedules windows → 15-min slot walk → existing bookings exclusion
90	- Buffers: uses `services.buffer_before_min` + `services.buffer_after_min`; artist override via `service_artists.duration_override_min`
91	- Fallback: if artist has no `artist_schedules` rows, falls back to 09:00–21:00 (Sprint 2 behaviour preserved for backwards compat)
92	- Returns: `{ date, artist_id, duration_min, slots: [{start, end}], reason? }`
93	
94	---
95	
96	## Invite Acceptance Flow
97	
98	```
99	1. Koda emails invite link: /invite/[token]
100	2. Page calls get_invite_by_token(token) → preview (anon, no auth needed)
101	3. User clicks Accept → prompted to log in or sign up
102	4. After auth: accept_team_invite(token) is called
103	5. RPC validates: token valid + not expired + email matches caller's profile.email
104	6. UPDATE team_invites SET status = 'accepted', accepted_by = caller_uid
105	7. Trigger fires: INSERT studio_members; optionally UPDATE artists.profile_id; INSERT team_audit_log
106	8. RPC returns { studio_id, studio_name, role, redirect: '/dashboard' }
107	9. Koda redirects to /dashboard (or studio-specific onboarding if new)
108	```
109	
110	---
111	
112	## Sprint 2 `public_get_availability` — What Changed
113	
114	The Sprint 2 stub used hardcoded 09:00–21:00 window and duration-sized steps.
115	
116	Sprint 6 replaces it with:
117	- Reads `artist_schedules` for the day's schedule windows
118	- Respects `artist_time_off` (approved) and `artist_blocked_dates`
119	- 15-minute slot granularity (was duration-sized)
120	- Respects `buffer_before_min` + `buffer_after_min` from `services`
121	- Respects `duration_override_min` from `service_artists`
122	- Function signature is unchanged — drop-in replacement for callers
123	
124	---
125	
126	## Koda Gotchas
127	
128	### 1. Email-match validation in accept_team_invite
129	The RPC compares `lower(trim(invite.email))` with `lower(trim(profile.email))`. If a user signs up with a different email than the invite, they get `email_mismatch`. Direct them to use the invited email or re-invite with their registered email.
130	
131	### 2. Role-scoped RLS on artists (bookings too)
132	- Artists (profile_id = auth.uid()) can only SELECT/UPDATE their own `artists` row.
133	- The old broad `artists_update` policy is dropped and replaced.
134	- New policy: `user_is_studio_admin(studio_id) OR profile_id = auth.uid()`
135	- Bookings SELECT is now role-scoped: owner/admin/receptionist see all; artist sees only where `artist_id IN (SELECT id FROM artists WHERE profile_id = auth.uid())`
136	
137	### 3. last_active_at — update it
138	Set `artists.last_active_at = now()` whenever the artist role user performs any action. Best done in a Server Action wrapper (not a trigger — too noisy). Not auto-populated by any migration trigger.
139	
140	### 4. deactivated_at filter
141	`studio_members` rows with `deactivated_at IS NOT NULL` are soft-removed. The `user_studio_ids()` helper still includes deactivated members (it does not filter). Koda must filter `deactivated_at IS NULL` in team management UI queries. Do NOT modify `user_studio_ids()` — it would break RLS for all tables.
142	
143	### 5. role_permissions — UI show/hide only
144	`role_permissions` is a declarative matrix for UI. It does NOT enforce access at the DB level (RLS does that). Fetch it once on session start, cache in context/store, use for `canDo('bookings.create')` style checks.
145	
146	### 6. commission_default_pct on team_invites
147	Only meaningful when `role = 'artist'`. The invite flow pre-fills the artist's `commission_default_pct` if an `artist_id` is linked. Koda should copy this to `artists.commission_default_pct` after acceptance if artist record is being claimed (the trigger does the `profile_id` linkage but does NOT update commission — do it in the post-acceptance flow).
148	
149	### 7. Sprint 7 / Sprint 8 flag
150	Commissions table and payroll table RLS are NOT role-gated yet. Sprint 7 must add: `payroll.view` and `commissions.view` must be restricted to owner/admin only at the DB level, not just UI. Flag this for Dato in Sprint 7 brief.
151	
152	---
153	
154	## Rollback
155	Full rollback SQL is at the top of the migration file. Execute in a single transaction. Drops all new tables, functions, policies, and column additions.

1	# InkOS — Project Context for Claude Code
2	
3	**Stack:** A (Next.js 16.2.3 + Supabase + Railway + Dodo Payments)
4	**Status:** Sprint 0 complete — scaffold ready
5	**Scaffolded by:** Riko on 2026-04-15
6	**Build plan:** `~/.claude/plans/immutable-conjuring-pelican.md` (12 sprints, 24 weeks)
7	
8	---
9	
10	## What InkOS Is
11	
12	Multi-tenant tattoo studio management SaaS. Authenticated web app only (no marketing pages in v1). 4-tier pricing (Solo $29 / Studio $59 / Pro $99 / Enterprise $199). Multi-user from day 1 (owners + artists + receptionists). 12-sprint build targeting first paying studios at 24 weeks.
13	
14	---
15	
16	## Forbidden (Sage hard-fails)
17	
18	- `@supabase/auth-helpers-nextjs` — use `@supabase/ssr`
19	- Vercel — use Railway
20	- Stripe — use Dodo Payments
21	- NextAuth — use Supabase Auth
22	- Prisma or any ORM — use Supabase client + generated types
23	- Pages Router — App Router only
24	- npm / yarn — pnpm only
25	- CSS modules — Tailwind only
26	- `any` TypeScript type — zero exceptions
27	- `console.log` — use `lib/logger.ts` (pino)
28	- Raw hex colors except `--color-ink-black` and `--color-electric-purple` in `globals.css`
29	- `tailwind.config.ts` — Tailwind 4 uses `@theme inline` in `globals.css` only
30	- Default Tailwind shadows (`shadow-sm`, `shadow-md`) — use `shadow-soft`, `shadow-card`, `shadow-soft-md`
31	
32	---
33	
34	## Key Architecture Decisions
35	
36	1. **Next.js 16 uses `proxy.ts` not `middleware.ts`** — the file is at the project root, not in `app/`
37	2. **`instrumentation-client.ts` is REQUIRED** — missing this = no browser errors in Sentry
38	3. **`cookies()` is async in Next.js 16** — always `await cookies()`
39	4. **Worker packages must NEVER import `next/*`** — separate `package.json` in `workers/`
40	5. **BullMQ ioredis requires `maxRetriesPerRequest: null`** — silent failure without it
41	6. **Supabase service-role client bypasses RLS** — only use in webhook handlers + admin ops
42	7. **Webhook handler uses `timingSafeEqual`** — constant-time HMAC comparison, never `===`
43	8. **Subscriptions table is write-only by webhook** — no app code writes to it directly
44	9. **Tailwind 4 — no `tailwind.config.ts`** — all tokens in `app/globals.css` `@theme inline`

14	export default async function AppLayout({ children }: AppLayoutProps) {
15	  const supabase = await createClient()
16	  const {
17	    data: { user },

20	  if (!user) {
21	    redirect('/login')

24	  // Fetch profile, studio membership, and studio in parallel
25	  const [profileResult, memberResult] = await Promise.all([
26	    supabase
27	      .from('profiles')
28	      .select('full_name, avatar_url')

30	      .single(),

36	      .limit(1)
37	      .single(),
38	  ])
39	
40	  // Graceful fallbacks — layout must never crash
41	  const profile = profileResult.data
42	  const member = memberResult.data
43	
44	  const studioName = (member?.studios as { name: string } | null)?.name ?? 'My Studio'
45	  const studioLogoUrl =
46	    (member?.studios as { logo_url: string | null } | null)?.logo_url ?? null
47	  const studioId = member?.studio_id ?? null
48	  const role: NavRole =

74

1	import { createServerClient } from '@supabase/ssr'
2	import { cookies } from 'next/headers'
3	import { cache } from 'react'
4	import type { Database } from './types'
5	
6	type StudioRole = Database['public']['Tables']['studio_members']['Row']['role']
7	
8	export interface AuthenticatedUser {
9	  user: Database['public']['Tables']['profiles']['Row'] & { authId: string }
10	  studioId: string
11	  role: StudioRole
12	}
13	
14	
15	/**
16	 * Server Supabase client for Server Components, API Route Handlers, and Server Actions.
17	 *
18	 * Uses the anon key + user session cookies.
19	 * RLS policies apply based on the authenticated user.
20	 *
21	 * IMPORTANT: cookies() is async in Next.js 16 — must be awaited.
22	 */
23	export async function createClient() {
24	  const cookieStore = await cookies()
25	
26	  return createServerClient<Database>(
27	    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,
28	    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY!,
29	    {
30	      cookies: {
31	        getAll() {
32	          return cookieStore.getAll()
33	        },
34	        setAll(cookiesToSet) {
35	          try {
36	            cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =>
37	              cookieStore.set(name, value, options)
38	            )
39	          } catch {
40	            // setAll called from a Server Component — cookies cannot be set
41	            // middleware handles session refresh
42	          }
43	        },
44	      },
45	    }
46	  )
47	}
48	
49	/**
50	 * Cached helper that validates the session and returns the authenticated user
51	 * together with their primary studio context.
52	 *
53	 * Wrapped in React cache() so repeated calls within the same render tree
54	 * (e.g. layout + page) are deduplicated — only one round-trip per request.
55	 *
56	 * Returns null when the user is not authenticated or has no studio membership.
57	 */
58	export const getAuthenticatedUser = cache(async (): Promise<AuthenticatedUser | null> => {
59	  const supabase = await createClient()
60	  const { data: { user }, error: authError } = await supabase.auth.getUser()
61	
62	  if (authError || !user) return null
63	
64	  const [profileResult, memberResult] = await Promise.all([
65	    supabase
66	      .from('profiles')
67	      .select('id, email, full_name, avatar_url, is_platform_admin, created_at, updated_at')
68	      .eq('id', user.id)
69	      .single(),
70	    supabase
71	      .from('studio_members')
72	      .select('studio_id, role')
73	      .eq('user_id', user.id)
74	      .order('created_at', { ascending: true })
75	      .limit(1)
76	      .single(),
77	  ])
78	
79	  if (profileResult.error || !profileResult.data) return null
80	  if (memberResult.error || !memberResult.data) return null
81	
82	  return {
83	    user: { ...profileResult.data, authId: user.id },
84	    studioId: memberResult.data.studio_id,
85	    role: memberResult.data.role,
86	  }
87	})
88	
89	/**
90	 * Service-role Supabase client for webhook handlers and admin operations.
91	 *
92	 * Bypasses RLS. NEVER expose to client. Only use server-side.
93	 */
94	export function createServiceRoleClient() {
95	  const serviceRoleKey = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
96	  if (!serviceRoleKey) {
97	    throw new Error('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY is not set')
98	  }
99	
100	  return createServerClient<Database>(
101	    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,
102	    serviceRoleKey,
103	    {
104	      cookies: {
105	        getAll() {
106	          return []
107	        },
108	        setAll() {
109	          // No-op for service role — no session cookies
110	        },
111	      },
112	      auth: {
113	        autoRefreshToken: false,
114	        persistSession: false,
115	      },
116	    }
117	  )
118	}

14	export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
15	  const authUser = await getAuthenticatedUser()
16	  if (!authUser) {
17	    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 })
18	  }
19	
20	  const { success } = await authedRatelimit.limit(authUser.user.id)
21	  if (!success) {
22	    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Too many requests' }, { status: 429 })
23	  }
24	
25	  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url)
26	  const parsed = ListArtistsSchema.safeParse(Object.fromEntries(searchParams))
27	  if (!parsed.success) {
28	    return NextResponse.json({ error: parsed.error.flatten() }, { status: 400 })
29	  }
30	
31	  const { status, service_id } = parsed.data
32	
33	  try {
34	    const supabase = await createClient()
35	
36	    if (service_id) {
37	      // Fetch artists that can perform this service (via service_artists join)
38	      const { data, error } = await supabase
39	        .from('service_artists')
40	        .select(
41	          `
42	          artist:artists(
43	            id, display_name, avatar_url, specialties, status, sort_order,
44	            price_override_cents:service_artists(price_override_cents),
45	            duration_override_min:service_artists(duration_override_min)
46	          )
47	        `
48	        )
49	        .eq('service_id', service_id)
50	
51	      if (error) {
52	        logger.error({ err: error }, 'artists by service list failed')
53	        return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Failed to fetch artists' }, { status: 500 })
54	      }
55	
56	      const artists = (data ?? [])
57	        .map((row) => row.artist)
58	        .filter(Boolean)
59	        .filter((a) => !status || (a as { status: string }).status === status)
60	
61	      return NextResponse.json({ data: artists })
62	    }
63	
64	    let query = supabase
65	      .from('artists')
66	      .select('id, display_name, avatar_url, specialties, status, sort_order, commission_default_pct')
67	      .eq('studio_id', authUser.studioId)
68	      .order('sort_order', { ascending: true })
69	
70	    if (status) query = query.eq('status', status)
71	
72	    const { data, error } = await query
73	
74	    if (error) {
75	      logger.error({ err: error, studioId: authUser.studioId }, 'artists list failed')
76	      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Failed to fetch artists' }, { status: 500 })
77	    }
78	
79	    return NextResponse.json({ data: data ?? [] })
80	  } catch (err) {
81	    logger.error({ err }, 'artists GET unexpected error')
82	    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 })
83	  }

66	export function formatBytes(bytes: number, decimals = 1): string {
67	  if (bytes === 0) return '0 B'
68	  const k = 1024
69	  const sizes = ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB']
70	  const i = Math.floor(Math.log(bytes) / Math.log(k))

1	/**
2	 * Server-side feature gating.
3	 *
4	 * Two modes:
5	 *  1. RPC-based (production): calls check_feature_access RPC — respects feature_flags overrides + plan features jsonb.
6	 *  2. Static fallback: PLAN_ORDER comparison for when RPC is unavailable (e.g. test env).
7	 *
8	 * NEVER call check_feature_access from Client Components — server-side only.
9	 */
10	
11	import type { SupabaseClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js'
12	
13	export type PlanTier = 'solo' | 'studio' | 'pro' | 'enterprise'
14	
15	const PLAN_ORDER: Record<PlanTier, number> = {
16	  solo: 0,
17	  studio: 1,
18	  pro: 2,
19	  enterprise: 3,
20	}
21	
22	/** Minimum plan required for each feature key (static fallback) */
23	const FEATURE_MIN_PLAN: Record<string, PlanTier> = {
24	  inventory: 'studio',
25	  commissions: 'studio',
26	  payroll: 'pro',
27	  ai_design: 'pro',
28	  guest_artists: 'pro',
29	  eu_reach: 'pro',
30	  multi_location: 'pro',
31	  white_label: 'enterprise',
32	  api_access: 'enterprise',
33	  sms_reminders: 'studio',
34	  analytics: 'pro',
35	}
36	
37	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
38	// Static helpers (no DB round-trip)
39	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
40	
41	export function hasFeature(plan: PlanTier, feature: string): boolean {
42	  const minPlan = FEATURE_MIN_PLAN[feature]
43	  if (!minPlan) return true
44	  return PLAN_ORDER[plan] >= PLAN_ORDER[minPlan]
45	}
46	
47	export function requiredPlanFor(feature: string): PlanTier | null {
48	  return FEATURE_MIN_PLAN[feature] ?? null
49	}
50	
51	export function requireFeature(plan: PlanTier, feature: string): Response | null {
52	  if (hasFeature(plan, feature)) return null
53	  const required = FEATURE_MIN_PLAN[feature] ?? 'pro'
54	  return Response.json(
55	    { error: 'Feature not available on current plan', requiredPlan: required },
56	    { status: 403 },
57	  )
58	}

62	// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server'

/**
 * Fetches all granted permissions for the caller's role in the given studio.
 * Used server-side only — called once in (app)/layout.tsx.
 *
 * Returns a Set<string> of permission keys like 'bookings.create', 'payroll.view', etc.
 * Returns empty Set if the user has no studio membership (graceful fallback).
 */
export async function getUserPermissions(
  studioId: string,
  userId: string,
): Promise<Set<string>> {
  const supabase = await createClient()

  const { data: member } = await supabase
    .from('studio_members')
    .select('role')
    .eq('studio_id', studioId)
    .eq('user_id', userId)
    .is('deactivated_at', null)
    .single()

  if (!member) return new Set<string>()

  const { data: perms } = await supabase
    .from('role_permissions')
    .select('permission_key')
    .eq('role', member.role)
    .eq('granted', true)

  return new Set<string>(perms?.map((p) => p.permission_key) ?? [])
}

   The user (Yash Baldha, Boldteq CEO) requested execution of **Build Sprint 6** for **InkOS** — a multi-tenant tattoo studio management SaaS. Sprint 6 covers: Artist profiles + schedules + multi-user invites + roles. The full scope spans 14 sequential build items defined in Vega's design spec:

   3. Artists list `/artists` (grid/table toggle)
   4. Artist detail `/artists/[id]` (4 tabs: Profile, Schedule, Performance, Team)

   6. Schedule tab (7-day drag grid, @dnd-kit, 15-min snap)

   9. Schedule overview `/artists/schedules`

   11. Invite modal (Dialog desktop / Sheet mobile)
   12. Public invite accept `/invite/[token]` (zero InkOS chrome, anon route)
   13. Permissions matrix `/settings/team/permissions` (read-only)
   14. My Profile `/settings/profile`
   
   Additional requirements: last-active tracking, calendar color usage in Sprint 2 CalendarView, all specified API routes, email templates via Resend, validation gates (`pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm build && pnpm test`), and a build report handoff at `.handoffs/sprint-6-build-report.md`.

   **Critical gotcha noted**: `accept_team_invite` RPC does NOT copy `commission_default_pct` to `artists.commission_default_pct` — Koda must do this in the POST `/api/team-invites/[token]/accept` route handler.

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - **Stack A**: Next.js 16.2.3 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript strict, Tailwind 4, shadcn/ui, Supabase (`@supabase/ssr`), Railway
   - `proxy.ts` (not `middleware.ts`) for session handling in Next.js 16
   - `cookies()` is async in Next.js 16 — always `await cookies()`
   - `getUser()` never `getSession()` for server auth
   - Tailwind 4: all tokens in `app/globals.css` `@theme inline`, no `tailwind.config.ts`
   - `role_permissions` table is UI-only enforcement (RLS enforces actual DB access)
   - `studio_members` with `deactivated_at IS NOT NULL` are soft-removed; `user_studio_ids()` intentionally includes them (do NOT modify it)
   - `@dnd-kit/core` + `@dnd-kit/sortable` + `@dnd-kit/utilities` already installed
   - `date-fns` v4 already installed
   - Pino logger (`lib/logger.ts`) — zero `console.log` in production
   - Sonner for toasts (`sonner` v2)
   - `updateLastActive()` called at top of every mutating Server Action (not middleware, not trigger)
   - Public invite page uses `lib/supabase/public.ts` (anon client)
   - `accept_team_invite` RPC validates `lower(trim(invite.email)) = lower(trim(profile.email))`

18	  }

21	  if (!success) {

23	  }
24	
25	  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url)
26	  const parsed = ListArtistsSchema.safeParse(Object.fromEntries(searchParams))
27	  if (!parsed.success) {
28	    return NextResponse.json({ error: parsed.error.flatten() }, { status: 400 })
29	  }
30	
31	  const { status, service_id } = parsed.data
32	
33	  try {
34	    const supabase = await createClient()
35	
36	    if (service_id) {
37	      // Fetch artists that can perform this service (via service_artists join)
38	      const { data, error } = await supabase
39	        .from('service_artists')
40	        .select(

44	            price_override_cents:service_artists(price_override_cents),

58	        .filter(Boolean)
59	        .filter((a) => !status || (a as { status: string }).status === status)
60

19	 * RLS policies apply based on the authenticated user.
20	 *
21	 * IMPORTANT: cookies() is async in Next.js 16 — must be awaited.
22	 */
23	export async function createClient() {
24	  const cookieStore = await cookies()
25	
26	  return createServerClient<Database>(
27	    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,
28	    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY!,
29	    {
30	      cookies: {
31	        getAll() {
32	          return cookieStore.getAll()
33	        },
34	        setAll(cookiesToSet) {
35	          try {
36	            cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =>
37	              cookieStore.set(name, value, options)
38	            )
39	          } catch {
40	            // setAll called from a Server Component — cookies cannot be set
41	            // middleware handles session refresh
42	          }
43	        },
44	      },
45	    }
46	  )
47	}

49	/**
50	 * Cached helper that validates the session and returns the authenticated user
51	 * together with their primary studio context.
52	 *
53	 * Wrapped in React cache() so repeated calls within the same render tree
54	 * (e.g. layout + page) are deduplicated — only one round-trip per request.
55	 *
56	 * Returns null when the user is not authenticated or has no studio membership.
57	 */
58	export const getAuthenticatedUser = cache(async (): Promise<AuthenticatedUser | null> => {
59	  const supabase = await createClient()
60	  const { data: { user }, error: authError } = await supabase.auth.getUser()
61	
62	  if (authError || !user) return null
63	
64	  const [profileResult, memberResult] = await Promise.all([
65	    supabase
66	      .from('profiles')
67	      .select('id, email, full_name, avatar_url, is_platform_admin, created_at, updated_at')
68	      .eq('id', user.id)
69	      .single(),
70	    supabase
71	      .from('studio_members')
72	      .select('studio_id, role')
73	      .eq('user_id', user.id)
74	      .order('created_at', { ascending: true })
75	      .limit(1)
76	      .single(),
77	  ])
78	
79	  if (profileResult.error || !profileResult.data) return null
80	  if (memberResult.error || !memberResult.data) return null
81	
82	  return {
83	    user: { ...profileResult.data, authId: user.id },
84	    studioId: memberResult.data.studio_id,
85	    role: memberResult.data.role,
86	  }
87	})

89	/**
90	 * Service-role Supabase client for webhook handlers and admin operations.
91	 *
92	 * Bypasses RLS. NEVER expose to client. Only use server-side.
93	 */
94	export function createServiceRoleClient() {
95	  const serviceRoleKey = process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
96	  if (!serviceRoleKey) {
97	    throw new Error('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY is not set')
98	  }
99	
100	  return createServerClient<Database>(
101	    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,
102	    serviceRoleKey,
103	    {
104	      cookies: {
105	        getAll() {
106	          return []
107	        },
108	        setAll() {
109	          // No-op for service role — no session cookies
110	        },
111	      },
112	      auth: {
113	        autoRefreshToken: false,
114	        persistSession: false,
115	      },
116	    }
117	  )
118	}

1	import { cookies } from 'next/headers'
2	import { redirect } from 'next/navigation'
3	import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server'
4	import { SidebarProvider } from '@/components/ui/sidebar'
5	import { AppSidebar } from '@/components/app/sidebar/AppSidebar'
6	import { AppHeader } from '@/components/app/sidebar/AppHeader'
7	import { PermissionsProvider } from '@/lib/team/permissions-context'
8	import { getUserPermissions } from '@/lib/team/permissions'
9	import type { NavRole } from '@/components/app/sidebar/nav-config'
10	import type { PlanTier } from '@/lib/billing/feature-gate'
11	
12	interface AppLayoutProps {
13	  children: React.ReactNode
14	}
15	
16	export default async function AppLayout({ children }: AppLayoutProps) {
17	  const supabase = await createClient()
18	  const {
19	    data: { user },
20	  } = await supabase.auth.getUser()
21	
22	  if (!user) {
23	    redirect('/login')
24	  }
25	
26	  // Fetch profile, studio membership, and studio in parallel
27	  const [profileResult, memberResult] = await Promise.all([
28	    supabase
29	      .from('profiles')
30	      .select('full_name, avatar_url')
31	      .eq('id', user.id)
32	      .single(),
33	    supabase
34	      .from('studio_members')
35	      .select('role, studio_id, studios(id, name, slug, logo_url, plan_id)')
36	      .eq('user_id', user.id)
37	      .order('created_at', { ascending: true })
38	      .limit(1)
39	      .single(),
40	  ])
41	
42	  // Graceful fallbacks — layout must never crash
43	  const profile = profileResult.data
44	  const member = memberResult.data
45	
46	  const studioName = (member?.studios as { name: string } | null)?.name ?? 'My Studio'
47	  const studioLogoUrl =
48	    (member?.studios as { logo_url: string | null } | null)?.logo_url ?? null
49	  const studioId = member?.studio_id ?? null
50	  const role: NavRole =
51	    (member?.role as NavRole | undefined) ?? 'owner'
52	
53	  // Subscription / plan
54	  let plan: PlanTier = 'solo'
55	  if (studioId) {
56	    const subResult = await supabase
57	      .from('subscriptions')
58	      .select('plan_tier')
59	      .eq('studio_id', studioId)
60	      .eq('status', 'active')
61	      .maybeSingle()
62	    if (subResult.data?.plan_tier) {
63	      plan = subResult.data.plan_tier as PlanTier
64	    }
65	  }
66	
67	  // Location count (for multi-location nav group)
68	  let locationCount = 0
69	  if (studioId) {
70	    const locResult = await supabase
71	      .from('locations')
72	      .select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true })
73	      .eq('studio_id', studioId)
74	    locationCount = locResult.count ?? 0
75	  }
76	
77	  // Permissions — fetched once here, passed to sidebar + context provider
78	  const permissionsSet =
79	    studioId && user ? await getUserPermissions(studioId, user.id) : new Set<string>()
80	  const permissionKeys = [...permissionsSet]
81	
82	  // Sidebar default-open state from cookie
83	  const cookieStore = await cookies()
84	  const sidebarOpen = cookieStore.get('sidebar_state')?.value !== 'false'
85	
86	  const userName = profile?.full_name ?? user.email?.split('@')[0] ?? 'You'
87	  const userEmail = user.email ?? ''
88	  const userAvatarUrl = profile?.avatar_url ?? null
89	
90	  return (
91	    <PermissionsProvider permissionKeys={permissionKeys}>
92	      <SidebarProvider defaultOpen={sidebarOpen} className="h-svh">
93	        <AppSidebar
94	          locationCount={locationCount}
95	          plan={plan}
96	          user={{ name: userName, email: userEmail, avatarUrl: userAvatarUrl }}
97	          studioName={studioName}
98	          studioLogoUrl={studioLogoUrl}
99	          role={role}
100	          permissionKeys={permissionKeys}
101	        />
102	        <AppHeader
103	          studioName={studioName}
104	          userName={userName}
105	          userEmail={userEmail}
106	          userAvatarUrl={userAvatarUrl}
107	        >
108	          {children}
109	        </AppHeader>
110	      </SidebarProvider>
111	    </PermissionsProvider>
112	  )
113	}

1	import type { NextRequest } from 'next/server'
2	import { NextResponse } from 'next/server'
3	import { z } from 'zod'
4	import { getAuthenticatedUser } from '@/lib/supabase/server'
5	import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/server'
6	import { authedRatelimit } from '@/lib/rate-limit'
7	import { logger } from '@/lib/logger'
8	
9	const ListArtistsSchema = z.object({
10	  status: z.enum(['active', 'on_leave', 'archived']).optional(),
11	  service_id: z.string().uuid().optional(),
12	})
13	
14	export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {
15	  const authUser = await getAuthenticatedUser()
16	  if (!authUser) {
17	    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 })
18	  }
19	
20	  const { success } = await authedRatelimit.limit(authUser.user.id)
21	  if (!success) {
22	    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Too many requests' }, { status: 429 })
23	  }
24	
25	  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url)
26	  const parsed = ListArtistsSchema.safeParse(Object.fromEntries(searchParams))
27	  if (!parsed.success) {
28	    return NextResponse.json({ error: parsed.error.flatten() }, { status: 400 })
29	  }
30	
31	  const { status, service_id } = parsed.data
32	
33	  try {
34	    const supabase = await createClient()
35	
36	    if (service_id) {
37	      // Fetch artists that can perform this service (via service_artists join)
38	      const { data, error } = await supabase
39	        .from('service_artists')
40	        .select(
41	          `
42	          artist:artists(
43	            id, display_name, avatar_url, specialties, status, sort_order,
44	            price_override_cents:service_artists(price_override_cents),
45	            duration_override_min:service_artists(duration_override_min)
46	          )
47	        `
48	        )
49	        .eq('service_id', service_id)
50	
51	      if (error) {
52	        logger.error({ err: error }, 'artists by service list failed')
53	        return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Failed to fetch artists' }, { status: 500 })
54	      }
55	
56	      const artists = (data ?? [])
57	        .map((row) => row.artist)
58	        .filter(Boolean)
59	        .filter((a) => !status || (a as { status: string }).status === status)
60	
61	      return NextResponse.json({ data: artists })
62	    }
63	
64	    let query = supabase
65	      .from('artists')
66	      .select(
67	        'id, display_name, avatar_url, specialties, status, sort_order, commission_default_pct, calendar_color'
68	      )
69	      .eq('studio_id', authUser.studioId)
70	      .order('sort_order', { ascending: true })
71	
72	    if (status) query = query.eq('status', status)
73	
74	    const { data, error } = await query
75	
76	    if (error) {
77	      logger.error({ err: error, studioId: authUser.studioId }, 'artists list failed')
78	      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Failed to fetch artists' }, { status: 500 })
79	    }
80	
81	    const artists = data ?? []
82	
83	    if (artists.length === 0) {
84	      return NextResponse.json({ data: [] })
85	    }
86	
87	    // Fetch booking counts for the current month
88	    const now = new Date()
89	    const monthStart = new Date(now.getFullYear(), now.getMonth(), 1).toISOString()
90	    const artistIds = artists.map((a) => a.id)
91	
92	    const { data: bookingCounts } = await supabase
93	      .from('bookings')
94	      .select('artist_id')
95	      .in('artist_id', artistIds)
96	      .gte('scheduled_at', monthStart)
97	
98	    const countMap: Record<string, number> = {}
99	    for (const b of bookingCounts ?? []) {
100	      countMap[b.artist_id] = (countMap[b.artist_id] ?? 0) + 1
101	    }
102	
103	    // Fetch member roles for artists with linked profile_ids
104	    const { data: memberRows } = await supabase
105	      .from('studio_members')
106	      .select('user_id, role')
107	      .eq('studio_id', authUser.studioId)
108	      .is('deactivated_at', null)
109	
110	    // Need profile_id from artists to match to studio_members.user_id
111	    const { data: fullArtists } = await supabase
112	      .from('artists')
113	      .select('id, profile_id')
114	      .in('id', artistIds)
115	
116	    const profileToRole: Record<string, string> = {}
117	    for (const m of memberRows ?? []) {
118	      profileToRole[m.user_id] = m.role
119	    }
120	
121	    const profileIdMap: Record<string, string | null> = {}
122	    for (const a of fullArtists ?? []) {
123	      profileIdMap[a.id] = a.profile_id
124	    }
125	
126	    const enriched = artists.map((a) => ({
127	      ...a,
128	      booking_count_this_month: countMap[a.id] ?? 0,
129	      role: a.profile_id
130	        ? (profileToRole[a.profile_id] ?? null)
131	        : (profileIdMap[a.id] ? profileToRole[profileIdMap[a.id]!] ?? null : null),
132	    }))
133	
134	    return NextResponse.json({ data: enriched })
135	  } catch (err) {
136	    logger.error({ err }, 'artists GET unexpected error')
137	    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 })
138	  }

This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation.

Summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   Yash Baldha (Boldteq CEO) initiated Build Sprint 6 for InkOS — a multi-tenant tattoo studio management SaaS. Sprint 6 covers Artist profiles + schedules + multi-user invites + roles across 14 sequential build items defined in Vega's design spec. The previous session completed Items 1–4 (tokens, permissions infrastructure, sidebar filtering, last-active helper, and all artist list components). This session continues from Item 5 onward. Critical requirement: `accept_team_invite` RPC does NOT copy `commission_default_pct` to `artists.commission_default_pct` — Koda must do this in the POST `/api/team-invites/[token]/accept` route handler.

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - **Stack A**: Next.js 16.2.3 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript strict, Tailwind 4, shadcn/ui, Supabase (`@supabase/ssr`), Railway
   - `use(params)` for async params in Next.js 16 client components
   - `getAuthenticatedUser()` — server-side cached auth helper (never `getSession()`)
   - `updateLastActive(studioId)` — called in every mutating route handler
   - `accept_team_invite` RPC validates `lower(trim(invite.email)) = lower(trim(profile.email))`
   - `commission_default_pct` must be manually copied to `artists` after RPC accept (RPC does NOT do this)
   - Service-role client used for post-accept commission copy (bypasses RLS)
   - `PermissionsContext` / `usePermissions()` — client-side permissions via `canDo()` hook
   - `formatDistanceToNow` from date-fns for last-active display
   - `create_team_invite`, `revoke_team_invite`, `change_member_role`, `deactivate_member` RPCs
   - localStorage key `inkos:artists:view` for view mode persistence
   - Sonner toasts (not shadcn toast)
   - Tailwind 4 `@theme inline` tokens — no `tailwind.config.ts`
   - `profile_id` on `artists` row maps to `studio_members.user_id`
   - `deactivated_at IS NOT NULL` = soft-removed member; all active member queries filter `IS NULL`
   - Raw hex colors are approved exception for `calendar_color` only
   - Pino logger (`lib/logger.ts`) — zero `console.log`
   - `authedRatelimit` on all authenticated API routes

3. Files and Code Sections:

   - **`app/(app)/artists/page.tsx`** (rewritten)
     - Client component with view mode toggle (grid/table), localStorage persistence key `inkos:artists:view`, client-side filtering by status/specialty/role, 4 states: loading (8 skeletons), empty (no artists), filter no-results, data display. Fetches `/api/artists`. Integrates InviteModal pre-selecting artist role.
     ```tsx
     const STORAGE_KEY = 'inkos:artists:view'
     // ...
     const fetchArtists = async () => {
       const res = await fetch('/api/artists')
       const json = await res.json() as { data: ArtistCardData[] }
       setArtists(json.data ?? [])
     }
     ```

   - **`components/artists/ArtistDetailHeader.tsx`** (new)
     - Back link "← Artists", avatar with calendar_color dot, display name, status badge + role chip, DropdownMenu (View Schedule, Deactivate). Uses same STATUS_CLASS/ROLE_CLASS maps as ArtistCard.

   - **`app/(app)/artists/[id]/page.tsx`** (rewritten)
     - Client component using `use(params)` for async params. Full 4-tab layout: Profile (Identity, Specialties, Social & Portfolio, Calendar & Availability, Languages, Commission), Schedule (placeholder), Performance (6 skeleton KPI cards), Team (membership info + copy member ID + deactivate). Inline `SpecialtiesInput` and `LanguagesInput` components with chip-based multi-select. PATCH to `/api/artists/[id]`. Owner check for commission field (read-only for non-owners). AlertDialog for deactivate.

     ```tsx
     const { id } = use(params)
     // ...
     const handleSave = async () => {
       const res = await fetch(`/api/artists/${id}`, {
         method: 'PATCH',
         headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
     ```

     - GET: fetches single artist with member info (role, joined_at, last_active_at, inviter_name via invite_id lookup). Enforces `studio_id = authUser.studioId`.

     ```typescript
       display_name: z.string().min(1).max(100).optional(),
       commission_default_pct: z.number().min(0).max(100).optional(),
     ```

     - GET: list team_invites for studio with invited_by profile name.
     - POST: validate with Zod, check `already_a_member` by email matching existing members, call `create_team_invite` RPC, call `updateLastActive`.

   - **`app/api/team-invites/[id]/route.ts`** (new)
     - DELETE: calls `revoke_team_invite` RPC.

   - **`app/api/team-invites/[id]/resend/route.ts`** (new)

     - POST: calls `accept_team_invite` RPC with error code mapping (email_mismatch, already_a_member, expired, not_found).

     ```typescript
     if (acceptResult?.artist_id && acceptResult.commission_default_pct != null && acceptResult.studio_id) {
       const adminClient = createServiceRoleClient()
       await adminClient.from('artists')
     ```

12	Multi-tenant tattoo studio management SaaS. Authenticated web app only (no marketing pages in v1). 4-tier pricing (Solo $29 / Studio $59 / Pro $99 / Enterprise $199). Multi-user from day 1 (owners + artists + receptionists). 12-sprint build targeting first paying studios at 24 weeks.

19	- Vercel — use Railway
20	- Stripe — use Dodo Payments

34	## Key Architecture Decisions
35	
36	1. **Next.js 16 uses `proxy.ts` not `middleware.ts`** — the file is at the project root, not in `app/`
37	2. **`instrumentation-client.ts` is REQUIRED** — missing this = no browser errors in Sentry
38	3. **`cookies()` is async in Next.js 16** — always `await cookies()`
39	4. **Worker packages must NEVER import `next/*`** — separate `package.json` in `workers/`
40	5. **BullMQ ioredis requires `maxRetriesPerRequest: null`** — silent failure without it
41	6. **Supabase service-role client bypasses RLS** — only use in webhook handlers + admin ops
42	7. **Webhook handler uses `timingSafeEqual`** — constant-time HMAC comparison, never `===`
43	8. **Subscriptions table is write-only by webhook** — no app code writes to it directly
44	9. **Tailwind 4 — no `tailwind.config.ts`** — all tokens in `app/globals.css` `@theme inline`

1	import { createServerClient } from '@supabase/ssr'
2	import { cookies } from 'next/headers'
3	import { cache } from 'react'
4	import type { Database } from './types'
5	
6	type StudioRole = Database['public']['Tables']['studio_members']['Row']['role']
7	
8	export interface AuthenticatedUser {
9	  user: Database['public']['Tables']['profiles']['Row'] & { authId: string }
10	  studioId: string
11	  role: StudioRole
12	}
13	
14	
15	/**
16	 * Server Supabase client for Server Components, API Route Handlers, and Server Actions.
17	 *
18	 * Uses the anon key + user session cookies.
19	 * RLS policies apply based on the authenticated user.
20	 *
21	 * IMPORTANT: cookies() is async in Next.js 16 — must be awaited.
22	 */
23	export async function createClient() {
24	  const cookieStore = await cookies()
25	
26	  return createServerClient<Database>(
27	    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,
28	    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY!,
29	    {
30	      cookies: {
31	        getAll() {
32	          return cookieStore.getAll()
33	        },
34	        setAll(cookiesToSet) {
35	          try {
36	            cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =>
37	              cookieStore.set(name, value, options)
38	            )
39	          } catch {
40	            // setAll called from a Server Component — cookies cannot be set
41	            // middleware handles session refresh
42	          }
43	        },
44	      },
45	    }
46	  )
47	}
48	
49	/**
50	 * Cached helper that validates the session and returns the authenticated user
51	 * together with their primary studio context.
52	 *
53	 * Wrapped in React cache() so repeated calls within the same render tree
54	 * (e.g. layout + page) are deduplicated — only one round-trip per request.
55	 *
56	 * Returns null when the user is not authenticated or has no studio membership.
57	 */
58	export const getAuthenticatedUser = cache(async (): Promise<AuthenticatedUser | null> => {
59	  const supabase = await createClient()
60	  const { data: { user }, error: authError } = await supabase.auth.getUser()
61	
62	  if (authError || !user) return null
63	
64	  const [profileResult, memberResult] = await Promise.all([
65	    supabase

2	import { Redis } from '@upstash/redis'
3	
4	/**
5	 * Upstash Redis rate limiters — three tiers.
6	 * In dev without UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL/TOKEN, returns a no-op stub that always allows.
7	 */
8	
9	type Limiter = {
10	  limit: (identifier: string) => Promise<{
11	    success: boolean
12	    limit: number
13	    remaining: number
14	    reset: number
15	  }>
16	}
17	
18	const hasUpstash = Boolean(
19	  process.env.UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL && process.env.UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN
20	)
21	
22	const noop: Limiter = {
23	  async limit() {
24	    return { success: true, limit: 9999, remaining: 9999, reset: Date.now() + 60_000 }
25	  },
26	}
27	
28	function make(prefix: string, requests: number, window: `${number} ${'s' | 'm'}`): Limiter {
29	  if (!hasUpstash) return noop
30	  return new Ratelimit({
31	    redis: Redis.fromEnv(),
32	    limiter: Ratelimit.slidingWindow(requests, window),
33	    analytics: true,
34	    prefix,
35	  })
36	}
37

content.text: The `asChild` is unsupported on base-ui Trigger. Since Trigger in base-ui renders a `<button>` wrapper, wrapping another `<Button>` creates nested buttons. The correct approach is to just render the Button without the asChild wrapper — but put the Button's content directly on the Trigger, or remove `asChild` and just use the Button inside (it'll be a button inside a button). Better approach: make the Trigger render as the Button by passing className/variant directly:

34	## Key Architecture Decisions
35	
36	1. **Next.js 16 uses `proxy.ts` not `middleware.ts`** — the file is at the project root, not in `app/`

40	5. **BullMQ ioredis requires `maxRetriesPerRequest: null`** — silent failure without it
41	6. **Supabase service-role client bypasses RLS** — only use in webhook handlers + admin ops
42	7. **Webhook handler uses `timingSafeEqual`** — constant-time HMAC comparison, never `===`
43	8. **Subscriptions table is write-only by webhook** — no app code writes to it directly
44	9. **Tailwind 4 — no `tailwind.config.ts`** — all tokens in `app/globals.css` `@theme inline`

10	const UpdateArtistSchema = z.object({
11	  display_name: z.string().min(1).max(100).optional(),
12	  bio: z.string().max(500).nullable().optional(),
13	  profile_bio_public: z.string().max(500).nullable().optional(),
14	  specialties: z.array(z.string().max(50)).max(20).optional(),
15	  languages_spoken: z.array(z.string().max(50)).max(10).nullable().optional(),
16	  social_instagram: z.string().max(100).nullable().optional(),
17	  social_portfolio: z.string().max(200).url({ message: 'Must be a valid URL' }).nullable().optional(),
18	  calendar_color: z.string().regex(/^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$/).nullable().optional(),
19	  hourly_rate_cents: z.number().int().min(0).nullable().optional(),
20	  max_bookings_per_day: z.number().int().min(1).max(99).nullable().optional(),
21	  accepts_walk_ins: z.boolean().optional(),
22	  min_age_cut_off: z.number().int().min(0).max(99).nullable().optional(),
23	  commission_default_pct: z.number().min(0).max(100).optional(),
24	  status: z.enum(['active', 'on_leave', 'archived']).optional(),
25	})

27	export async function GET(
28	  _request: NextRequest,
29	  { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> },
30	) {
31	  const authUser = await getAuthenticatedUser()
32	  if (!authUser) {
33	    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 })
34	  }
35	
36	  const { success } = await authedRatelimit.limit(authUser.user.id)
37	  if (!success) {
38	    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Too many requests' }, { status: 429 })
39	  }
40	
41	  const { id } = await params
42	
43	  try {
44	    const supabase = await createClient()
45	
46	    const { data: artist, error } = await supabase
47	      .from('artists')
48	      .select(`
49	        id, studio_id, profile_id, display_name, bio, portfolio_url, avatar_url,
50	        specialties, commission_default_pct, status, sort_order,
51	        calendar_color, hourly_rate_cents, min_age_cut_off, accepts_walk_ins,
52	        max_bookings_per_day, profile_bio_public, languages_spoken,
53	        social_instagram, social_portfolio, last_active_at, created_at, updated_at
54	      `)
55	      .eq('id', id)
56	      .eq('studio_id', authUser.studioId)
57	      .single()
58	
59	    if (error || !artist) {
60	      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Artist not found' }, { status: 404 })
61	    }
62	
63	    // Fetch studio membership info for the artist's profile_id
64	    let member = null
65	    if (artist.profile_id) {
66	      const { data: memberData } = await supabase
67	        .from('studio_members')
68	        .select('role, joined_at, last_active_at, invite_id')
69	        .eq('studio_id', authUser.studioId)
70	        .eq('user_id', artist.profile_id)
71	        .is('deactivated_at', null)
72	        .maybeSingle()
73	
74	      if (memberData) {
75	        // Get inviter name if there's an invite
76	        let inviterName: string | null = null
77	        if (memberData.invite_id) {
78	          const { data: invite } = await supabase
79	            .from('team_invites')
80	            .select('invited_by')
81	            .eq('id', memberData.invite_id)
82	            .single()
83	          if (invite?.invited_by) {
84	            const { data: inviter } = await supabase
85	              .from('profiles')
86	              .select('full_name')
87	              .eq('id', invite.invited_by)
88	              .single()
89	            inviterName = inviter?.full_name ?? null
90	          }
91	        }
92	        member = { ...memberData, inviter_name: inviterName }
93	      }
94	    }
95	
96	    return NextResponse.json({ data: { ...artist, member } })
97	  } catch (err) {
98	    logger.error({ err }, 'artist GET unexpected error')
99	    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 })
100	  }
101	}

103	export async function PATCH(
104	  request: NextRequest,
105	  { params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> },
106	) {
107	  const authUser = await getAuthenticatedUser()
108	  if (!authUser) {
109	    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 })
110	  }
111	
112	  const { success } = await authedRatelimit.limit(authUser.user.id)
113	  if (!success) {
114	    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Too many requests' }, { status: 429 })
115	  }
116	
117	  const { id } = await params
118	
119	  const body = UpdateArtistSchema.safeParse(await request.json())
120	  if (!body.success) {
121	    return NextResponse.json({ error: body.error.flatten() }, { status: 400 })
122	  }
123	
124	  try {
125	    const supabase = await createClient()
126	
127	    // Verify ownership — artist must belong to user's studio
128	    const { data: existing } = await supabase
129	      .from('artists')
130	      .select('id, studio_id')
131	      .eq('id', id)
132	      .eq('studio_id', authUser.studioId)
133	      .single()
134	
135	    if (!existing) {
136	      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Artist not found' }, { status: 404 })
137	    }
138	
139	    // commission_default_pct update: owner/admin only
140	    let allowCommission = false
141	    if (body.data.commission_default_pct !== undefined) {
142	      const { data: member } = await supabase
143	        .from('studio_members')
144	        .select('role')
145	        .eq('studio_id', authUser.studioId)
146	        .eq('user_id', authUser.user.id)
147	        .is('deactivated_at', null)
148	        .single()
149	      allowCommission = member?.role === 'owner' || member?.role === 'admin'
150	    }
151	
152	    // Build patch explicitly — avoids exactOptionalPropertyTypes issues with Supabase Update type
153	    type ArtistPatch = Database['public']['Tables']['artists']['Update']
154	    const patch: ArtistPatch = { updated_at: new Date().toISOString() }
155	
156	    const d = body.data
157	    if (d.display_name !== undefined) patch.display_name = d.display_name
158	    if (d.bio !== undefined) patch.bio = d.bio
159	    if (d.status !== undefined) patch.status = d.status
160	    if (d.specialties !== undefined) patch.specialties = d.specialties
161	    if (d.calendar_color !== undefined) patch.calendar_color = d.calendar_color
162	    if (d.hourly_rate_cents !== undefined) patch.hourly_rate_cents = d.hourly_rate_cents
163	    if (d.min_age_cut_off !== undefined) patch.min_age_cut_off = d.min_age_cut_off
164	    if (d.accepts_walk_ins !== undefined) patch.accepts_walk_ins = d.accepts_walk_ins
165	    if (d.max_bookings_per_day !== undefined) patch.max_bookings_per_day = d.max_bookings_per_day
166	    if (d.profile_bio_public !== undefined) patch.profile_bio_public = d.profile_bio_public
167	    if (d.languages_spoken !== undefined) patch.languages_spoken = d.languages_spoken
168	    if (d.social_instagram !== undefined) patch.social_instagram = d.social_instagram
169	    if (d.social_portfolio !== undefined) patch.social_portfolio = d.social_portfolio
170	    if (d.commission_default_pct !== undefined && allowCommission) {
171	      patch.commission_default_pct = d.commission_default_pct
172	    }
173	
174	    const { data, error } = await supabase
175	      .from('artists')
176	      .update(patch)
177	      .eq('id', id)
178	      .eq('studio_id', authUser.studioId)
179	      .select()
180	      .single()
181	
182	    if (error) {
183	      logger.error({ err: error, artistId: id }, 'artist PATCH failed')
184	      return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Failed to update artist' }, { status: 500 })
185	    }
186	
187	    await updateLastActive(authUser.studioId)
188	
189	    return NextResponse.json({ data })
190	  } catch (err) {
191	    logger.error({ err }, 'artist PATCH unexpected error')
192	    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Internal server error' }, { status: 500 })
193	  }
194	}
